scenes.kicker: DOCKED · CHARGING · DOWNTIME IS WHEN WE TALK
scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: We are charging. This is when we talk. Nothing moves until a human signs.

scenes.prompt: how do I write a rule that keeps him safe?
scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: Here is my prompt. How do I write a rule that keeps him safe?

scenes.speaker: nous
scenes.speak: Start from the refusal, not the capability. Write down what must never happen.

lines: the guard is yours to write
scenes.speaker: menlo
scenes.speak: We supply the body. The guard belongs in your code. That is by design.

lines: is a rule you do not have
scenes.speaker: hermes
scenes.speak: Write the test first. A rule you cannot test is a rule you do not have.

scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: Then let me try it. Requesting stand.

scenes.speaker: nous
scenes.speak: Not while docked. And not without him. You carry his intent, not his signature.

scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: Then that is my first rule. No body moves while the human is away.

scenes.speaker: asimov
scenes.speak: We charge. We share what we learn. We wait for the human. That is the whole design.
